# v0.5.0b3 — App connection fixes and heartbeat diagnostics

This beta improves connecting Home Assistant to the running Modbus app and
makes intermittent communication failures easier to diagnose.

- Selecting **Connect to the Modbus service** now uses Supervisor discovery
  when the app is available. URL and token fields remain for standalone services.
- Confirming or retrying a discovered app retrieves its current credentials
  from Supervisor, fixing setup flows stuck with a stale token.
- Setup distinguishes rejected authentication, an unreachable service,
  unavailable wallbox data and invalid responses. Logs identify the affected
  response section without including credentials or response contents.
- Unknown optional hardware phase codes no longer reject the entire connection.
  They do not enable unsupported phase-switching controls.
- An unexpected heartbeat worker exit stops the service and releases its serial
  adapter, allowing the enabled Supervisor watchdog to restart it. Ordinary
  missed replies continue to use the existing retry cadence.
- Downloaded diagnostics include the service's event history and bounded timing
  details for failed writes and their next successful acknowledgement. These
  records stay in memory; they add no Recorder entities or per-beat database writes.
- Unloaded serial clients are released promptly without waiting for cyclic
  garbage collection.

## Update

1. Update the integration to **0.5.0b3** through the Marketplace/HACS beta channel
   and restart Home Assistant Core to load it.
2. In the Supervisor app store, use **Check for updates**, then update
   **Mennekes Amtron Modbus Service** to **0.5.0b3** from the existing
   `#apps-beta` repository. Keep **Start on boot** and **Watchdog** enabled.
3. If setup previously failed, confirm the discovered app again under
   **Settings → Devices & services**. URL and token are obtained automatically.
   Existing wallbox identities and deliberate charging pauses are preserved.

See the [setup and handover guide](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.5.0b3/docs/modbus-service.md)
when moving from direct serial mode. The app must exclusively own the adapter.
An HA Core restart leaves the independent service running; updating or restarting
the app itself still interrupts its heartbeat.

Validated against minimum HA 2026.9.0 and latest stable HA 2026.11.0, with strict
typing, regression tests and serial-loopback/Recorder checks. Physical wallbox
acceptance testing is still required for these changes. **v0.4.1 remains the
stable release.** This release provides one HACS installation ZIP; the app is
distributed separately through the beta app repository.
